description: Add stdin interactive protocol to CLI Adapter for ongoing process communication
steps: In src/nexus/adapters/cli_adapter.py, add send_message(session_id, message) async method that writes to the running process's stdin pipe and returns acknowledgment
Add is_interactive flag to session metadata (set during _do_create_session based on config)
Add awaiting_input state tracking in session metadata that tracks whether the process is waiting for stdin input
Add _stream_output(process, session_id) async helper that reads stdout line-by-line incrementally and appends to session logs
Handle edge cases: process already exited (raise RuntimeError), stdin pipe broken (BrokenPipeError handling), encoding issues (use errors='replace')

Create tests/test_cli_adapter_interactive.py with tests using mock subprocess covering: send_message to running process, send_message to exited process, is_interactive flag, awaiting_input state, _stream_output line reading, broken pipe handling
acceptance_criteria: pytest tests/test_cli_adapter_interactive.py passes all new tests
send_message() writes to stdin of running process and handles errors gracefully
is_interactive and awaiting_input state properly tracked
